Coil then make a strong crossing double cut, left then right blade, compact crossed slash streaks; guard crosses BOTH blades. ROW3 hit recoil and recovery; ROW4 defensive guard and recovery using this actual equipment, no extra sword; ROW5 evasive crouch step then recovery; ROW6 collapse/defeat ending lying motionless. SAME costume throughout: athletic adult European-looking man with short chestnut hair, polished blue-grey plate shoulders and cuirass, cream and royal blue surcoat with gold sun trim, brown gauntlets and armoured boots. Weapon must remain recognizable, same proportions, grip anatomically correct. No swords except those explicitly requested. No touching neighbours. Solid opaque magenta everywhere between characters, no transparency. 6 columns, 6 rows, 36 poses.
